summary_bullets: File Tier B stall reports in the resolved upstream larch repository with exact-signature dedup.
Keep Tier A on the current /larch:issue path while adding a normalized dedup pre-pass.
Separate public report dedup signatures from retry signatures and document the public safety boundary.
commit_message:
Implement upstream stall report filing dedup

Add metadata-based upstream repository resolution and a cross-repo filing helper with exact larch-stall signature dedup, structured duplicate comments, and fallback-print statuses.

Wire /implement stall recovery to emit public REPORT_DEDUP_SIGNATURE markers, normalize helper output, expose Tier A dedup, and file Tier B reports upstream with bounded comment payload validation. Update stall recovery docs and SECURITY.md for the public upstream filing boundary.
